student_card: For each of 0,1,2,3,4,9,11,15,21, state odd or even, and prime, composite or neither. Give the positive factor pairs for9 and15. Decide whether every odd whole number is prime and whether0 is even. Work individually first, then compare reasons with a partner. Whole numbers here are0,1,2,…; a prime is an integer greater than1 with exactly two positive divisors.

Whole numbers here are0,1,2,…; a prime is an integer greater than1 with exactly two positive divisors.

Even:0,2,4; odd:1,3,9,11,15,21. Prime:2,3,11; composite:4,9,15,21; neither:0,1. Factorpairs9:(1,9),(3,3);15:(1,15),(3,5). Odd9 is composite;0=2×0 is even. A whole number n is rational as n/1; there are no irrational whole numbers. Preserve the source competency wording in metadata but explicitly explain this distinction.
